profile.summary: notrab demonstrates strong expertise in Node.js and Express.js backend development with a focus on server-side rendering, template engine migrations, and dependency management. Their contributions are primarily centered around maintaining and improving Express.js examples, particularly around transitioning from Jade/Pug to EJS templates. While their skills are backend-focused, there is no evidence of frontend JavaScript frameworks or modern tooling like TypeScript, testing frameworks, or build systems. Their experience level is assessed as Mid based on the depth of contributions to a well-known framework repository and their demonstrated ability to handle dependency cleanup and documentation updates with backward compatibility in mind.
